svg.title: Maze Maker roadmap, as of 2026-11-01
svg.desc: Maze Maker roadmap as of 2026-11-01. Done: Phase 1, the table and the viewer, closed (1.0 Skeleton, 1.1 First look at the table and 1.3 Filter the table done; 1.2 Explore one tile folded into 2.2; 1.4 Table checks and 1.5 Full tile set v1 dropped). From Phase 2, done: 2.1 First sample maze, 2.2 Why is this here?, 2.3 Tune and compare, and 2.6 Beyond the edge steps 1 (growth from open endpoints), 2 (the measures) and 3 (the World tab, walk and replay). Now, the main track: the game, ahead of the rest of Phase 2 (DR-0042). G.1 Walk a growing world is in progress (DR-0042 to DR-0045, building apps/game/); then G.2 Save and load and G.3 Debug mode, pending. The tool, only on demand: new tool work comes only from issues the game finds. 2.6 step 2b, the walker that avoids backtracking, is parked unless the game wants it; 2.3 follow-ups, 2.4 Watch it collapse and 2.5 Judge many samples are kept for if the game needs them. Later, not planned: a different 3D game, probably in Unity, built on this approach with the maze generator attached in its own thread (Q-0014); zones; rooms with no way in.
svg.text: As of 2026-11-01 · drawn from docs/roadmap.md · the game is now the main track; the tool moves only when the game needs it
Phase 1 closed; most of Phase 2 landed on main
PHASE 1: THE TABLE AND THE VIEWER
PHASE 2: SAMPLE MAZES (TOOL) AND BEYOND THE EDGE (ENGINE)
Now: the game, the main track
Ahead of the rest of Phase 2 (DR-0042)
Ian: “please prioritize the actual game now”
